products.label: A
products.reason: It is the same enterprise fax offering as the prior fax API and fax integration services, just delivered as a cloud service.

products.label: B
products.reason: It is an email messaging delivery service for enterprise customers, which fits the firm’s existing cloud messaging and business communications offerings.

products.label: C
products.reason: It extends the firm’s document and messaging workflow capabilities, but adds a broader automation layer beyond the earlier fax, EDI, and file-transfer services.

products.label: D
products.reason: It targets the same email customer base as the earlier archiving and encryption products, but expands into advanced security monitoring and prevention.

products.label: E
products.reason: It builds on the firm’s existing email security offerings, especially email encryption and archiving, by adding malware scanning.

products.label: F
products.reason: It is another email-security control for the same customers as the prior email products, but focuses on blocking specific attachments rather than protecting or storing mail.
